evidence_class.point_forecast: R (V0 corrected public data; walk-forward; consumed seasons 2022-2025; development folds 2019-2021)

control_model.note: Production Start Value is the control; unchanged. It contains ffopportunity xFP (betting-derived) for seasons >= 2021 and equals noX before.

protocol.walk_forward: train 2016..Y-2, select on Y-1 per position (PPR MAE), score once on Y
protocol.outcome: next-game PPR points, played only; missing stays missing

betting_derived_inputs: ffopportunity v1.0.0-data xFP (X, X_season, xfp metrics)

notes: Rosterable flag uses as-of Q only
Outcomes are read only from case.outcome
No 2026 file exists in the data directory or provenance
